help:
Commands for this chat:
/new — start a new conversation
/conversations — list the latest conversations
/open N — continue conversation N from the list
/rename title — rename the current conversation
/delete N — delete conversation N from the list (asks to confirm)
/yes — confirm what was asked
/help — show these commands
new_started: New conversation started. Your next message goes to it.
list_footer: Send /open N to continue one, or /delete N to delete it.
list_needed: Send /conversations first, then use the number from the list.
unknown_number: There is no conversation {n} in the last list. Send /conversations to see it again.
rename_empty: Give the new title after the command, for example: /rename Justice and power
rename_too_long: That title is too long; use up to 120 characters.
no_current: There is no conversation to rename yet. Send a message or use /new.
delete_ask: Delete “{title}”? Its messages and replies leave the conversation archive, in every interface, and this cannot be undone. Reply /yes within 2 minutes to confirm.
changed: That conversation changed elsewhere, so nothing was done. Send /conversations to see it as it is now.
unavailable: The conversation archive did not answer just now. Try again in a moment.
